summary: Phase 1 increment verified end-to-end. BACKEND (5/5 pytest in test_guided_repair_and_security.py + 34/34 regression in test_predictions_and_isolation.py + test_security.py): (1) SECURITY GUARD confirmed — server.py line 1814 raises HTTPException(403,'Developer mode is disabled') when APP_ENV != 'development'; static source check + runtime auth check pass. Anonymous POST /api/subscription/developer/set correctly rejected (401/403). In THIS preview APP_ENV=development so authed calls succeed as designed. (2) AUTH register/login round-trip works with password Jarvis2026!. (3) POST /api/ai/analyze returns text body ~20s for the Guided Repair prompt (JARVIS Cloud AI, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY). FRONTEND (Playwright 390x844): (A) GUIDED REPAIRS — Direct nav /guided-repair?code=P0300&desc=Misfire renders ECU DATA tag + 'P0300 — Misfire' and REAL VEHICLE DATA/UNAVAILABLE row (guest sees UNAVAILABLE — connect & decode VIN; authed user sees '2018 Jeep Wrangler JL'). Tapping gr-start invokes ai.analyze; on AUTHED session AI response arrives in ~20s with clearly labeled sections (Problem Summary, Why It Matters, Possible Causes, Diagnostic Checks, Step-by-Step Repair, Safety Warnings), 'AI ANALYSIS · GENERAL GUIDANCE' pill + JARVIS Cloud AI engine badge, full safety disclaimer ('AI-generated general guidance…verify exact procedures, torque values and part numbers against the manufacturer service manual…'), and testID='gr-recheck' → 'POST-REPAIR: OPEN CODES TO RE-SCAN' outlined button that routes to /codes. On AI failure (guest hits /api/ai/analyze without token → 401), the retry card testID='gr-retry' correctly shows 'Not authenticated — tap to retry' and NO fake content is rendered. (B) CODES PAGE — In simulation, Read Codes fetches 3 DTCs (P0300, etc.); tapping the P0300 card (testID='code-P0300') navigates to /guided-repair?code=P0300&desc=Random%2FMultiple%20Cylinder%20Misfire%20Detected — matches spec. Clear Codes confirmation dialog is wired (Alert.alert with destructive style). no-live-data gate (testID='codes-no-live') is present in code when hasLiveData=false. (C) ABOUT — SUPPORT & CONTACT card renders with testID='about-contact', MichaelBryant@JarvisAutoAI.com and JarvisAutoAI.com are both in the DOM and visible in the screenshot. (D) BRANDING — 'JARVIS Auto AI' text on auth screen (login/register) and About header. REGRESSION — Guest dashboard shows live simulated gauges (SystemNominal, RPM/SPEED/COOLANT/BATTERY etc. — SimulationProvider active on web preview). Login/Register/Guest auth flows all functional. Predictions honesty (34/34) and backend user isolation (per test_predictions_and_isolation) untouched. No red screen, no crash.

ui_bugs.issue: Business contact row uses the shared Row style with numberOfLines={1} + maxWidth:'60%' + textTransform:'capitalize'. This truncates 'MichaelBryant@JarvisAutoAI.com' with an ellipsis on 390px and renders the website as 'JarvisAutoAI.Com' (unwanted capital C after the dot). Suggest a dedicated ContactRow with wrapping (numberOfLines>=2) and no capitalize transform. Reference: /app/frontend/app/about.tsx:127-134 and rowValue style at 148.

issues: Email/website truncated by shared Row style; also textTransform:'capitalize' causes 'JarvisAutoAI.Com' & 'Gr_2abd9410@Example.Com' — cosmetic but visible on the Account + Support cards.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — pre-existing across the app; cosmetic on web, does not affect native. Recommend a future pass to migrate.

action_items: Optional low-priority: in about.tsx, replace the shared Row for SUPPORT & CONTACT with a wrapping ContactRow (or drop numberOfLines={1}/maxWidth and textTransform:'capitalize' on rowValue) so the full email/website are visible without ellipsis and without odd casing.
Optional: migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents' to 'style.pointerEvents' to silence RN Web deprecation warnings (not blocking).
Not testable in web preview (documented): real BLE DTC read/clear on a physical OBD-II adapter — requires a native build.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1811-1815 — Dev endpoint guard is correctly placed as the first statement inside developer_set (after Depends(get_current_user)): if APP_ENV != 'development' -> 403 BEFORE any DB write. In production the endpoint will refuse to grant Pro/Shop. Verified via static source check.

guided-repair.tsx — Prompt correctly forbids fabricated vehicle-specific specs and instructs the model to say 'Look up the exact spec … I won't guess.' The AI response is rendered as plain text only after a successful analyze; on failure ONLY the retry card is shown (no partial/fake content). Source rows are labeled ECU DATA (red) for the code and REAL VEHICLE DATA (green) or UNAVAILABLE (secondary) for the vehicle — matches the spec.
codes.tsx:114-119 — Code card wraps in Pressable with router.push('/guided-repair?code=...&desc=...') using encodeURIComponent — correct URL construction verified end-to-end.
codes.tsx:39-48 — Clear Codes uses Alert.alert with a destructive Clear Codes button and clear disclaimer that clearing does NOT repair the fault. Good UX + safety.
about.tsx:101-107 — SUPPORT & CONTACT card uses testID='about-contact' and mailto: linking; correct. See UI bug above about visual truncation only.
server.py is ~1884 lines — carry-over recommendation from iterations 15/16 to split into routers (auth/vehicles/predictions/ai/subscription/shop). Not blocking Phase 1.
